en: The postcard features two black-and-white photographs of a building labeled 'Villa Sonnenheim' in Bad Pyrmont. The villa is shown from two angles, both partially obscured by trees, with one view highlighting the entrance and the house's sharply pitched roof. The reverse side contains a green postage stamp with 'Deutsches Reich', handwritten notes, postal markings, and a blue stamp from the 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont'. There is also printed text in German describing Villa Sonnenheim and its proximity to the spa park and baths.
